csv_project_name: Design Svc for Duck Samford Park Expansion Project
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Auburn ( City ) is seeking a qualified firm ( Firm ) to provide layout and design services for the Duck Samford Park Expansion Project. The City is requesting presentation of qualifications for the full design as well as associated coordination and inspection for the facility. Scope of Work: The City is requesting qualifications for delivery of plans and specifications to develop 21-acres of City-owned property as an expansion to the existing facilities at Duck Samford Park (see Exhibit A for site). The expansion is planned to include, but not necessarily be limited to new baseball fields, practice facilities, restrooms & concessions buildings, parking lots and ingress/egress from adjacent roadways.
